{{Quote|For better or worse, Ramil has continued our father's work, dismantling the Serenno military, replacing it with security droids loyal only to him.|Dooku|<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />}}
The '''Serenno military''' was the military of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] [[Serenno]] and its [[Serenno system|system]]. The Serenno military was founded by [[Serenno (individual)|Serenno]], the individual who led the charge against the [[Sith Empire]] which occupied Serenno and its system. When [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Gora]] became the ruler of Serenno however, the defence force was slowly decommissioned in favor of [[droid]]s.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost">''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]''</ref> By [[23 BBY]],<ref name="Dooku Assassin Date">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' dates the recruitment of [[Asajj Ventress]] as [[Dooku]]'s [[assassin]] to 23 [[Standard year|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[23 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. As ''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' takes place after Dooku recruited Ventress, the mission must have occured around 23 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> during Count [[Dooku]]'s reign, the military was disbanded.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />
